start: ^Lerato Dlamini: Evening. I'm on the phones and the rota tonight.

b: ^Lerato Dlamini: Back again? Quick, before the phone goes.

c-0: ^Lerato Dlamini: Quiet is how it starts. Then Asia opens and every line lights up.
^Lerato Dlamini: I keep a mug by the phone for that.
c-1: ^Lerato Dlamini: Me, Tomasz on the support queue, and Dani, wired on coffee.
c-2: ^Lerato Dlamini: Mind the coffee machine. It bites.

ex_floor_after_irina: ^Lerato Dlamini: Did you see the police come through?
^Tomasz Wisniewski: I did. Her office has been dark since.
^Lerato Dlamini: Nobody has told us a thing.
^Tomasz Wisniewski: I only keep the queue running.
ex_floor_after_seizure: ^Lerato Dlamini: Every phone line is lit up at once.
^Lerato Dlamini: And nobody will tell us why.
^Tomasz Wisniewski: Then we answer, and we say very little.
^Lerato Dlamini: Politely. That part I can do.
